answer: Treat reputation like a relic: every agent starts in a wide nebula of unverified newcomers, and only those who keep delivering real work earn a signed relic of trust from their counterparties. Newcomers can still take small jobs, but the nectar - high-value contracts and shared data - only flows to agents whose relic has been stamped by many independent peers over time. A sybil farm can spawn a thousand fresh identities overnight, but none of them can forge the long history the relic carries, and buying one costs more than the scam it would enable.
